historical_reviews.deepseek: Useful for enumeration and general OFED state, but changes source coverage: none of its commands proves the literal mlxlink physical-port and PCIe counter views, and `head -n 20` can omit ports.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly makes mlxlink primary and supporting tools secondary, while requiring full output and device/port identity.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row151 separately checks PCIe capability/status/AER bits using `lspci -vvv`; this row covers Mellanox link-tool physical and PCIe views and must not absorb or replace AER semantics.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Bind mlxlink device and port to PCI BDF, NIC serial/PN and cable/switch peer; preserve complete command output; compare negotiated state, firmware and counters to a project recipe rather than merely requiring command success.

original_test_intent: Confirm that each intended Mellanox NIC/port is enumerated and that mlxlink reports the expected physical-link state, negotiated speed/bandwidth, firmware identity and PCIe-side counters for the project topology.
original_method: Record SUT, NIC model/PN/serial, PCI BDF, netdev/RDMA device, mlxlink device name, physical port and peer/cable identity; approve/install a compatible vendor tool stack; capture complete versions and baseline; run both exact source mlxlink views without truncation; correlate their device/port identities to lspci, mst and ibstat; compare link state, Ethernet/InfiniBand protocol, lane count, speed, width/bandwidth, firmware and counter values/deltas with the approved recipe; preserve logs and avoid any link-reset or configuration options.
manual_activity: The network/platform owner approves the OFED/MFT tool build, target device/port/peer mapping and expected values; the agent can then collect and normalize the two read-only source views.
required_inputs: SUT and each Mellanox NIC model/PN/serial, PCI BDF, netdev/RDMA name and mlxlink device identifier
Physical port1 cable/transceiver/switch peer and intended Ethernet or InfiniBand mode
Supported OFED/MFT/mst/mlxlink/ibstat package versions and pinned reviewed internal Script revision
Expected firmware, link state, protocol, lane count, speed, PCIe generation/width and effective bandwidth
Counter names, units, baseline/window and allowed absolute/delta thresholds
Secure access and escalation policy for down/degraded link, firmware mismatch or increasing counters
safety_requirements: Use only verified read-only information/counter forms; do not invoke link toggles, port configuration, reset or firmware operations
Confirm device and port mapping before running; do not guess `<device name>` or assume port1 maps to the tested connector
Capture complete output and exit status; do not use `head`/`tail` to conceal devices, ports or counters
Use secure injected credentials and verified host identity; reject password-in-command and disabled host-key checking
Stop and preserve evidence on mapping ambiguity, disappearing device, link flap, degraded width/speed or rapidly increasing error counters
agent_execution_scope: Verify approved package/tool versions and target identity mapping
Run both exact read-only mlxlink source commands plus full lspci/mst/ibstat support collection
Normalize negotiated link/firmware/counter evidence against the supplied recipe
Do not install packages without approval, mutate link/firmware, guess target or expected values, truncate output or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve tool stack and internal Script revision
Provide exact NIC/BDF/mlxlink/port/peer topology and expected negotiated values
Review complete evidence and issue the DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial mismatch: lspci/mst/ibstat help identify the NIC but do not replace either source mlxlink physical-port/PCIe counter command; truncating ibstat can omit relevant ports.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run complete `mlxlink -d <verified-device> -p 1 -c` and `mlxlink -d <verified-device> --port_type PCIE -c` with version/exit/timestamp evidence, then correlate full lspci/mst/ibstat output using secure transport.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Mellanox NIC, physical port1, PCIe port type, `-c` counter/info views, installation criterion, Common branch, internal Script reference and 15/5-minute estimate are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the two source mlxlink views as primary evidence, correlated to immutable NIC/port/peer identity and compared with a versioned negotiated-state/counter recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity correlation, tool provenance, complete evidence, exact expectations and counter-delta semantics while retaining both commands.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Enumeration or a command exit0 does not prove the correct port, expected link speed/width/bandwidth, firmware or acceptable counters.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Counters may be cumulative and link state depends on peer/cable configuration; a passive snapshot cannot prove stability without a defined observation window.

project_override_considerations: The internal Script URL is a package pointer, not self-validating evidence. Its revision and generated command/device mapping must be reviewed before use.
expected_evidence: SUT/NIC PN/serial/BDF/netdev/RDMA/mlxlink device and physical port/peer/cable map
OS/kernel/driver/firmware and OFED/MFT/mst/mlxlink/ibstat versions plus approved package/Script revision
Full lspci/mst/ibstat correlation and expected-versus-observed link/protocol/speed/width/bandwidth/firmware matrix
Counter baseline/delta/threshold analysis, relevant driver/kernel logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The two commands and criteria consistently request Mellanox physical and PCIe information. The word `correctable` is interpreted conservatively as correct/expected information pending the explicit project oracle, not as contradictory AER coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Supported tools, topology and expected values are identifiable normal prerequisites; absence makes execution pending but not the review intrinsically blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row150 Wistron-HW Robust-00028-V002: provide each Mellanox NIC PN/serial/BDF/netdev/RDMA/mlxlink device and port1 cable/transceiver/peer mapping; approve OFED/MFT/mlxlink/mst/ibstat versions and pinned internal Script revision; define expected Ethernet/InfiniBand mode, physical/PCIe link state, lane count, speed, generation/width, bandwidth, firmware and complete counter names/units/baseline/delta thresholds plus escalation criteria.

review_improvement: Restores both omitted mlxlink commands, prevents truncated fallback evidence from substituting for source coverage and adds immutable port/topology plus expected-value/counter-delta comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: MST identifiers, PCI BDFs, RDMA names and physical connectors are different namespaces; without an explicit mapping, a healthy output can belong to the wrong NIC or port. The first source command reports the physical-port view while `--port_type PCIE` changes the observation plane. lspci and ibstat cannot reproduce every mlxlink firmware, lane/bandwidth and counter field. Because counters may be cumulative, acceptance also needs a baseline and interval rather than a generic no-error assertion.
